settings.subtitle: Everything you need on the day, in one place. For signed-in attendees only.

cards.title: Workshop setup
cards.text: Clone the starter repos and install the toolchain before you arrive. Setup notes: git clone example.com/horizon/workshops

cards.title: Venue map
cards.text: Main Stage on the ground floor, Halls A and B on level 1, Workshop Lab and Studio 5 at the north end.

cards.title: Recordings
cards.text: Session recordings appear here within 48 hours of each talk.

cards.title: Safety team
cards.text: On site all three days. Call or text +1 (512) 555-0127 any time.

cards.title: Your calendar
cards.text: Every session page has an Add to calendar button that downloads an .ics file.
